name: BRO wrapper callback double-mint SolvBTC drain
summary: The BRO wrapper's mint() pulls the full ERC-3525 position in with safeTransferFrom, whose onERC721Received callback independently mints the same value before the outer mint() mints again, so the attacker looped burn-then-mint 22 times to compound 135.364250355343316230 BRO into 567,758,681.358134582535027962 BRO, traded 165,592,064.418235422750668661 BRO for 38.047405138108322251 SolvBTC from the treasury, and swapped that into 1211.054376965512754134 ETH in the same transaction.
notes: Beacon-proxy BRO wrapper deployed pointing at beacon 0x031c97141721d8ceeb74f96684e4e712fcd6fefd, which still resolves to the vulnerable implementation and emits no upgrade events; the implementation runtime hashes identically at deployment and immediately before the incident.

Exact receipt accounting: one SolvBTC Transfer of 38.047405138108322251 from treasury 0xfb2dc2428b6c2fb149a3e6d658fdf979cc0afef9 to the attacker main contract, plus 22 BRO burns and 44 BRO mints evidencing the double-mint loop, all inside the single attack transaction. SolvBTC is valued at BTC parity via the 2026-03-05 CoinGecko daily close; the in-tx Uniswap conversion into 1211.054376965512754134 ETH corroborates the magnitude. The 402,166,616.939899159784359301 leftover BRO sent to the attacker EOA is unbacked supply, not counted. No attacker-supplied campaign inputs besides gas.
